Whether you are an experienced professional or a young talent beginning your industrial career, we provide opportunities that challenge you, inspire you, and help you build a meaningful future.

CONTACT US Why Work With Us? A workplace built on integrity, innovation, and continuous growth.

Career Growth We promote internal talent and support long-term development.

Safe Work Environment We follow strict PPE, SOP, and safety compliance at every level.

Transparent Culture We believe in teamwork, honesty, and ethical industrial practices.

Modern Infrastructure Access to advanced reactors, QC labs, and automated systems.

Current Job Openings Explore opportunities to be part of our growing industrial team.

Production Supervisor Oversee production operations, ensure batch quality, safety compliance, and team coordination.

about-us.content:
NAYARA INDUSTRIES > About Nayara Industries | Chemical Manufacturer & Supplier in Ankleshwar Products 0 + Products 0 + Products 0 + ABOUT US Learn about Nayara Industries, a chemical manufacturing and trading company in GIDC Ankleshwar specializing in solvents, intermediates, and industrial chemicals with strict QC systems.

NAYARA INDUSTRIES is an emerging chemical manufacturing and trading company based in GIDC Ankleshwar, one of India’s largest chemical industrial zones. We specialize in the production, sourcing, and distribution of high-quality industrial chemicals used across pharmaceuticals, textiles, agriculture, water treatment, dyes, intermediates, and specialty chemical sectors.

Built on the principles of quality, compliance, safety, and continuous improvement, our organization is committed to serving domestic and international clients with reliable chemical solutions.

CONTACT US WHO WE ARE?

NAYARA INDUSTRIES is a chemical manufacturing and distribution company committed to delivering dependable and high-quality chemical products for industrial use. With a strong foundation in process expertise, supply chain management, and regulatory compliance, we serve industries that demand reliability, purity, and consistency.

We operate from GIDC Ankleshwar, giving us privileged access to India’s most mature chemical ecosystem and logistics infrastructure.

:root{ --card-gap: 22px; /* gap between cards */ --card-padding: 24px; /* inner padding */ --card-radius: 16px; --card-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); /* glass panel */ --card-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); --backdrop-blur: 12px; --accent: #0b84ff; --muted: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); --title-color: #ffffff; --anim-duration: 700ms; /* entrance animation duration */ --float-duration: 8s; /* breathing float */ --shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(2,8,20,0.24); } /* Page wrapper to demonstrate transparent background */ .vmcv-wrapper { width: 100%; padding: 28px 16px; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; justify-content: center; } /* Cards grid */ .vmcv-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: var(--card-gap); width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; align-items: stretch; /* equal height */ } /* Card base */ .vmcv-card { background: var(--card-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--backdrop-blur)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--backdrop-blur)); border: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius: var(--card-radius); padding: var(--card-padding); box-sizing: border-box; color: var(--muted); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); transform-origin: center; overflow: hidden; /* entrance animation */ opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px) scale(.995); animation: vmcv-in var(--anim-duration) cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1) forwards; } /* stagger entrance delays for a nicer effect */ .vmcv-card:nth-child(1){ animation-delay: 0ms; } .vmcv-card:nth-child(2){ animation-delay: 110ms; } .vmcv-card:nth-child(3){ animation-delay: 220ms; } /* gentle floating background layer for life */ .vmcv-card::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -10%; z-index: -1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,132,255,0.04), rgba(11,132,255,0.02)); filter: blur(28px); opacity: 0.9; transform-origin: center; border-radius: calc(var(--card-radius) * 1.3); animation: vmcv-float var(--float-duration) ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; } /* Hover motion: lift + pop layered content forward */ .vmcv-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 26px 60px rgba(2,8,20,0.34); } /* inner elements for layered pop */ .vmcv-card .vmcv-head, .vmcv-card .vmcv-body, .vmcv-card .vmcv-footer { transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.35,1); transform: translateZ(0); backface-visibility: hidden; } /* pop layers on hover */ .vmcv-card:hover .vmcv-head { transform: translateZ(18px) translateY(-4px); } .vmcv-card:hover .vmcv-body { transform: translateZ(8px); } .vmcv-card:hover .vmcv-footer { transform: translateZ(4px); } /* Title */ .vmcv-title { font-size: 20px; margin: 0; color: var(--title-color); letter-spacing: 0.2px; } /* Accent underline */ .vmcv-accent { height: 4px; width: 56px; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), #6fd3ff); } /* Content area grows to keep equal height */ .vmcv-body { font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 4px; flex: 1 1 auto; /* makes body take remaining height */ overflow: auto; } /* Footer — small, centered CTA or value list */ .vmcv-footer { margin-top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; } /* Core Values styling (pill list) */ .vmcv-values { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .vmcv-value { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: var(--muted); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } /* optional small CTA button style (if you want to add) */ .vmcv-cta { margin-left: auto; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: var(--muted); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .vmcv-cta:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); transform: translateY(-3px); } /* equalize height visuals for very long text — limit body scroll if needed */ .vmcv-body::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 6px; width: 6px; } .vmcv-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 6px; } /* responsive: stack on small screens */ @media (max-width: 880px){ .vmcv-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } /* animations */ @keyframes vmcv-in { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px) scale(.995); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } } @keyframes vmcv-float { 0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity:0.88; } 50% { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.005); opacity:1; } 100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity:0.88; } } /* reduced motion support */ @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .vmcv-card, .vmcv-card::after, .vmcv-card .vmcv-head, .vmcv-card .vmcv-body, .vmcv-card .vmcv-footer { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; transform: none !important; } } Vision Mission Core Values Vision To become a leading, trusted, and innovation-driven chemical manufacturer delivering sustainable solutions to industries across India and global markets.

} /* each stacked block */ .tab-block { margin-bottom: var(--outer-gap); } /* hide native radio inputs */ .tab-input { display:none; } /* label (tab header) - full width center aligned */ .tab-label { display:inline-block; width:100%; text-align:center; padding: var(--tab-pad-y) var(--tab-pad-x); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); cursor: pointer; font-weight:700; font-size: 18px; position: relative; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background .18s ease; } .tab-label:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } /* glowing underline slightly lower */ .tab-label::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); bottom: -10px; /* lower underline */ width: 0%; height: var(--underline-height); opacity: 0; } /* checked (active) styles */ .tab-input:checked + .tab-label { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(11,132,255,0.12), rgba(84,215,255,0.06)); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(11,132,255,0.10); } .tab-input:checked + .tab-label::after { width: 48%; opacity: 1; } /* content panel */ .tab-panel { display: none; margin-top: 18px; animation: panelIn .42s ease; } .tab-input:checked + .tab-label + .tab-panel { display: block; } /* grid of cards */ .feature-grid { display: grid; gap: var(--card-gap); grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); } /* card */ .feature-card { background: var(--glass-bg); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); border-radius: var(--card-radius); padding: var(--card-pad); backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)); box-shadow: var(--shadow); color: var(--muted); transition: transform .26s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.35,1), box-shadow .26s ease; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; } .feature-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 26px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); } /* title */ .f-title { margin:0; font-weight:700; color: var(--title-color); font-size: 15px; line-height:1.35; } /* tags row */ .tag-row { display:flex; gap: var(--tag-gap); flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:6px; } /* individual tag (chip) */ .tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding: var(--tag-padding); border-radius: var(--tag-radius); background: var(--tag-bg); color: var(--tag-color); font-weight:600; font-size: var(--tag-font-size); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); white-space:nowrap; } /* small accent variant for tag (blue) */ .tag.accent { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(11,132,255,0.14), rgba(84,215,255,0.06)); border: 1px solid rgba(11,132,255,0.14); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(11,132,255,0.06); } /* panel animation */ @keyframes panelIn { from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(8px);} to{opacity:1; transform:none;} } /* responsive tweaks */ @media (max-width: var(--mobile-break)){ .tab-label { font-size: 16px;
